title: Three Terms and One Short Spring
subtitle: 引力物理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 引力物理（科学与技术·物理与力学）
meta: 主题语境：引力物理（科学与技术·物理与力学）　|　核心词汇：force　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 force 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the physicist ① measured a force that no student in the lab would have named, and he said the measuring was the whole of the term. The ② force, meaning the push itself and not the weight, ran three terms and stayed unnamed in the book; a force, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ force in that lab had the same short spring beside it, and the ④ force at the far bench, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A force, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; the physicist said the naming is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the force was the whole of the matter, meaning the troop and not the push. The ⑥ force, meaning the troop and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody names; force, he said, is either something you measure or the only word that means both a push and a troop. He said the troop is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ force had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short spring. The ⑧ force of the whole thing, the physicist wrote in March, was one lab and three terms of naming; force, he said, is either the one at the far bench or the reason you learned to name. He said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ force I remember is the one named in the plan, which closed in 1972 and is still described as the quietest in the lab. A ⑩ force, my mother said in 1974, is the only one that improves by being named; every force, she said, is a troop that has agreed to look like a push. She said the troop was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 力；作用力（指实验室里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 力（指那一个本身，与重力相对）
C. 固定搭配：measure a force 测量一个力
D. n. 力（指留给孩子们的那一组）
E. n. 力（抽象总称，指一间实验室的测力之事）
F. n. 力（指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一个）
G. n. 军队；部队（the forces / a peacekeeping force，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 军队（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

items.q: measured a force that no student in the lab would have named
The force, meaning the push itself and not the weight
the force at the far bench

The force of the whole thing

answers.why: measure a force 意为“测量一个力”，1963 年那位物理学家测了一个实验室里没有一位学生肯说出名字的力。
force 意为“力”，指那一个本身而不是重力，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被说出名字。
force 意为“力”，指实验室里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一根短短的弹簧。
force 意为“力”，指留给孩子们的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
force 意为“军队、部队”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这支部队就是那件事的全部。
force 意为“军队”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那一个力，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
force 意为“力”，指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一个，到 1970 年这一个成了计划里的一行。
force 意为“力”，物理学家三月写道，整件事的测力之事是一间实验室和三个学期的说出名字。
force 意为“力”，我记得的是计划里被说出名字的那一个，1972 年结束了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一个。
force 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，一个力是唯一会因为被好好说出名字而变得更好的东西。
